$comment: Invariant ids owned by the P1 task `p1-session-runtime` (packages/core/src/session). The integrate task merges these into docs/invariants-owned.json, which is what `pnpm test:coverage-map` reads; this file is the per-task claim so two lanes cannot silently claim the same id or drop one between them.

notOwned.INV-COM-05: the width/colour tween is a UI-layer S invariant (packages/ui, P3), not a runtime one
notOwned.INV-SCH-06: the scheduler lane owns the endgame generator; session/ only asserts the generation half

stubs: GradingPort — implemented by packages/core/src/grading (other P1 lane); session/test-doubles.ts ships ScriptedGrading against the real interface.
SchedulerPort — implemented by packages/core/src/scheduler (other P1 lane); session/test-doubles.ts ships RecordingScheduler.
FlavourMatrixPort — the plan puts the flavour matrix in packages/core/src/economy; DEFAULT_FLAVOUR_MATRIX is the in-lane source until that lands.
SessionStore — the SQLite table and migration belong to packages/schema; InMemorySessionStore is the reference implementation the properties run against.
